messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "ensure family or caregiver knows which symptoms may be serious"
set: ["ensure family or caregiver knows which symptoms may be serious", "family or caregivers should be alert to changes in mood or symptoms", "family or caregivers should monitor mood or symptoms", "tell family members or caregivers which symptoms to watch for so they can call provider if not able to", "be sure your doctor knows if you also use", "caregiver should be trained before first dose", "healthcare provider or adult caregiver", "doctor may occasionally change dose to ensure best results", "may be taken with or without food", "symptoms may occur with or without using medication", "caregiver should give naloxone", "dose adjustments or alternative treatments may be available", "may be increased by 20 or 40 mg", "stopping suddenly may cause increased seizures or withdrawal symptoms", "symptoms may not appear straight away", "caregiver may need to perform CPR while waiting for help"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
